title: A 45 mm anti-tank gun opens on the Tiger's flank; the Tiger answers through its sight
caption: GUNNER / 45 MM ANTI-TANK GUN AT 240 M - HITS - ANSWER
historical_scope: Staged fixture: the winter encounter's gun A with its crew; the tank platoons withdrawn and the tungsten rounds withheld so the clip shows the 45 mm BR-240 alone; the Tiger broadside at 240 m with the fight started and its gun laid on gun A. Kubinka 1943: the 45 mm armour-piercing round did not penetrate the Tiger's side; a 45 mm hit at 30-200 m broke tracks.
